LanguageData.BluesEnableMenus: Enable float menus for manual invites
LanguageData.BluesEnableAutoDesc: Let colonists organise group hangouts and sweep their lovers off their feet on their own.
LanguageData.BluesNoJoySpot: Not a fun place to hang out.
LanguageData.BluesNoRoomForJoy: Not enough space for everyone to chill.
LanguageData.BluesJoyDrainToDesc: Before a shared event, recreation is lowered to this value so colonists stay together longer before getting bored.\nRecreation already below this is left alone.
LanguageData.BluesMaxRecToTrigger: Max recreation level to allow manual invites: {0}%
LanguageData.BluesMaxRecToTriggerDesc: Colonists above this recreation level turn down manual invites.
LanguageData.BluesMaxRecAutoTrigger: Max recreation level to allow auto events: {0}%
LanguageData.BluesMaxRecAutoTriggerDesc: Colonists above this recreation level are left out of autonomous events.\nOnly applies while recreation draining is off.
LanguageData.BluesNeedFrenDesc: Both colonists must like each other at least this much before one can invite the other. Applies to manual invites and autonomous events.
LanguageData.BluesNeedLoveDesc: Both lovers must like each other at least this much before one can carry the other. Applies to manual orders and autonomous carries.
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryPlay: Lovers sweep each other off their feet to hangouts: {0}%
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryPlayOff: Lovers sweep each other off their feet to hangouts: off
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryBed: Lovers sweep each other off their feet to bed: {0}%
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryBedOff: Lovers sweep each other off their feet to bed: off
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryPlayDesc: The chance that a colonist carries their lover to hang out instead of walking.\nThe final chance is this value multiplied by the lower of the two lovers' opinions of each other.
LanguageData.BluesLoverCarryBedDesc: When a colonist heads to a bed they share with their lover, this is the chance they turn around, fetch the lover and carry them to bed too. Rolled once per bedtime, per colonist.\nThe final chance is this value multiplied by the lower of the two lovers' opinions of each other. Never fires while the lover is on work hours, already in bed, or the colony is in danger.
LanguageData.BluesScheduleJoyDesc: Colonists whose schedule says Recreation can start or join autonomous group events.
LanguageData.BluesScheduleAllDesc: Colonists whose schedule says Anything can start or join autonomous group events, interrupting ordinary work.\nEmergencies, player orders, rituals and caravans won't be interrupted.
LanguageData.BluesGroupJoysPerDayDesc: How many autonomous group events the colony aims for per day, spread across the allowed hours below.
LanguageData.BluesActiveHours: Allowed hours for autonomous group events:
LanguageData.BluesActiveHoursDesc: Left-click an hour to allow group events in it, right-click to forbid.\nBedtime carries just follow sleep time.
LanguageData.BluesRequireProximityDesc: How far apart two colonists can be and still invite each other, unless they're already in the same room.
LanguageData.BluesInfiniteRange: Maximum tile range for invitations: Unlimited
LanguageData.BluesNoRange: No invitations unless in the same indoor room
LanguageData.BluesRoomPickiness: Pickiness about where to hang out: {0}%
LanguageData.BluesRoomPickinessOff: Pickiness about where to hang out: off
LanguageData.BluesRoomPickinessDesc: How much the room matters when choosing where to hang out.\n0%: any usable spot at random. Higher: favours rec rooms, impressive rooms and the outdoors in nice weather, and shies away from bedrooms and hospitals.\nPrisons will never be used.
LanguageData.BluesRespectAreasDesc: Autonomous group events won't send a colonist to a spot outside their allowed area.\nManual invites will ignore this.
LanguageData.BluesExtendBuildingsDesc: Lets "Relax at ..." and autonomous events use art pieces, meditation foci and graves, which no JoyGiverDef lists by name.
LanguageData.BluesEnableActivityMenuDesc: Adds "Invite ... to an activity" on a colonist, for recreation that has no building to click: walks, skygazing, swimming, reading, meditation, drugs and treats.
LanguageData.BluesArtAllTaken: Only one colonist can admire {0} at a time. A group needs one artwork each, in the same room.
LanguageData.BluesGraveAllTaken: Only one colonist can pay respects at {0} at a time. A group needs one grave each, close together.
LanguageData.BluesNoMeditationSpot: No free spot to sit and meditate around {0}.
LanguageData.BluesNoSpotBeside: No free spot left beside {0} to sit down, chair or bare ground.
LanguageData.BluesNeedsChairToWatch: {0} needs a free chair to watch from - one per viewer.
LanguageData.BluesSeatsOnly: {0} only takes {1} at a time. The others need one of their own, or another activity.
LanguageData.BluesResetDefaultsDesc: Puts every Shared Joys setting back to its default value.\nSettings are global: the change applies to the current game and to every other game once this window is closed.
LanguageData.BluesAutoOffNote: Autonomous group events are off, so the settings that shape them (hours, daily events, range, room pickiness, areas, lovers carrying each other) are hidden. Turn the switch above back on to show them.
